## abyssctl host setup

Set up the Host for Abyss

### Synopsis

Sets up the Host for Abyss. It needs root.

This build does not have host setup yet: it exits 1 without changing anything.

```
abyssctl host setup [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sudo abyssctl host setup
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for setup
```
